user.title: Connect Taiwan Water
user.description: The integration first checks the latest bill. It uses the local OCR add-on when available; otherwise it opens a manual CAPTCHA step. Account details and raw responses are never placed in entity IDs or diagnostics.

data_description.water_id: 11 letters or digits; spaces and hyphens are removed.
data_description.customer_name: Name used by the official bill detail form.
data_description.name: Name shown for this integration device.
data_description.ocr_url: Leave blank to discover the local HAOS add-on or use native OCR when available.
data_description.history_limit: Choose the maximum history to backfill after the latest bill is verified.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure account
reconfigure.description: Verify the account against a fresh latest-bill query. To use a different water account number, add a separate integration entry.

data_description.water_id: 11 letters or digits; spaces and hyphens are removed.

data_description.name: Name shown for this integration device.
data_description.ocr_url: Leave blank to discover the local HAOS add-on or use native OCR when available.
data_description.history_limit: Choose the maximum history to keep importing after verification.

manual.title: Enter CAPTCHA manually
manual.description:
Enter the code from this one-time image within three minutes.

![CAPTCHA]({captcha_url})

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the service. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The water account number or customer name was rejected.
error.captcha_required: The CAPTCHA was rejected or expired. Enter the new image.
error.ocr_unavailable: OCR is unavailable. Enter the CAPTCHA manually.
error.site_changed: The official site response has changed and cannot be verified safely.
error.invalid_ocr_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS OCR URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_water_id: Enter an 11-character water account number using letters and digits.
error.invalid_captcha: Enter the 4–8 letter or digit code shown in the image.
error.invalid_history_limit: History limit must be 0 or greater.

abort.already_configured: This water account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Reconfiguration cannot change the water account assigned to this entry.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The account was verified and updated.
abort.manual_expired: The manual CAPTCHA session expired. Start the flow again.
